item.title: Happy belated 102nd birthday to the first Black pitcher in C…
item.author: Congressman Wesley Bell (@repwesleybellmo.bsky.social)
item.description:
Happy belated 102nd birthday to the first Black pitcher in Cardinals history, Bill Greason!

From being one of the first Black Marines and fighting in the Battle of Iwo Jima, to the last surviving Negro Leagues player, to a pastor for 50 years, Bill is a LEGEND and an inspiration.

Happy birthday!
